Demand mode works without setting it first, and Claude knows what TT is for.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Demand mode is the real default.** As long as the options had never been saved, every call and every reply was checked, as in `permanent` mode. An unset mode counts as `demand`, as the README says.
- **Claude knows what TT means.** In a turn with `TT`, the note on the prompt tells Claude that the word is your signal for the second look. Before, Claude read `TT` as part of the message and tried to work out what it meant.
